title: Research and design of record: state of the art, cleanliness-level spec, ADRs
description: Turn the session research (web prior art, local reference skills, lore/quest CLI surfaces, Claude Code built-ins, machine inventory) into lore docs: a state-of-the-art reference, the cleanliness-levels spec (C1-C5 x safety classes S0-S3, protected set, reach), ADRs for the five ratified decisions, an epic and one story per skill, and an upstream-findings reference for lore-cli/quest-cli.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/reference holds a state-of-the-art survey with a source URL on every external claim
docs/specs holds the cleanliness-levels spec defining C1-C5, S0-S3, the protected set, and reach per level
five ADRs record: plugin of focused skills, defer to opum-sdlc, shared plan/apply engine, opt-in provenance ledger, graduated reach
an upstream-findings reference lists each lore-cli/quest-cli finding with version, repro, exit code, and classification

implementationNotes: Evidence: docs/reference/state-of-the-art-in-agentic-housekeeping.md (URL per external claim), docs/specs/cleanliness-levels.md (C1-C5, S0-S3, protected set, reach; calibrated after engine build: unknown junk S2, stopped-container rm S2, clean-room unknown ignored S3), ADRs 0001-0005, docs/reference/upstream-findings.md (a-h), lore check exit 0 at commit 9b37895.
